title: Japan, US Decry Latest Beheading by Islamic State
main_content:
Japan and the United States have condemned Islamic State extremists for the apparent beheading of a Japanese journalist, hours after a grisly Internet video showed the execution.

Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe called the killing an “inhumane and contemptible act of terrorism” and vowed he would never forgive the killers. In Washington, President Barack Obama described the killing as “heinous murder.”

Kenji Goto’s wife, Rinko, issued an emotional appeal late Thursday to both Tokyo and Amman to save her husband’s life. But the audio recording, apparently released by the Islamic State, did not promise that either of the hostages would be released in exchange for Rishawi.

Days ahead of Saturday’s video, Islamic State released footage showing Goto holding pictures of another Japanese hostage, Haruna Yukawa, who had apparently been beheaded. In that video, a man’s voice, identifying himself as Goto, directly addresses Japan’s Abe, accusing him of responsibility for Yukawa’s death.

Goto is believed to have been captured by Islamic State last year while trying to rescue Yukawa.

The hostage crisis comes as Islamic State militants have captured large areas of Iraq and Syria, declaring the region a caliphate that all other Muslims should follow.

questions.question: How did the world find out about the execution?
options: A news article published by the Japanese government
An Internet video released by Islamic State
A press conference held by President Obama
Photos leaked from Kenji Goto's family
questions.answer: An Internet video released by Islamic State

questions.question: How did Shinzo Abe react to the news?
options: He expressed sorrow but called for calm
He condemned the act as inhumane and vowed never to forgive the killers
He stated that such events are part of war
He announced plans to increase military presence in the region
questions.answer: He condemned the act as inhumane and vowed never to forgive the killers

questions.question: Which other politician reacted immediately?
options: The Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
The Secretary General of the United Nations
A senior official from the Japanese embassy
